title: The Execution Layer: Darren Indyke Across Four Technology Deals
scope: Cross-deal reconstruction of Darren Indyke's documented legal, administrative and transaction-execution role across ESW, Blockstream/Kyara III, Reporty/ERGO and Levitection/Radar.

sources.supports: Epstein email to Darren Indyke, with Kahn copied, subject 'go ahead with the million for esw'.
sources.limit: Approval routing does not prove sourcing or original investment selection.

sources.supports: March 19, 2010 $1M Financial Trust wire instruction for ESW convertible-debenture subscription.
sources.limit: OCR of sender name is degraded; companion approval email identifies Indyke as execution recipient.

sources.supports: Posted JPM debit confirming ESW funding settled.
sources.limit: Settlement evidence does not identify the investment selector.

sources.supports: $500,001 Kyara III wire authorization to fund Blockstream, bearing Darren Indyke signature.
sources.limit: Signing/authorization does not establish sourcing or strategy.

sources.supports: Posted Southern Financial banking evidence for Kyara III transaction.
sources.limit: Statement is less descriptive than signed authorization.

sources.supports: Barak sends Reporty term sheet to 'Jeff and Darren' and asks for approval/movement forward.
sources.limit: Term-sheet review is not closing proof.

sources.supports: Barak refers to Darren's remarks and asks whether Darren should join the call.
sources.limit: Does not establish authorship of every economic term.

sources.supports: Barak says Darren already has the Reporty term sheet and capital table.
sources.limit: Possession/review does not equal investment selection.

sources.supports: Southern Trust $1M ERGO wire memorandum with reference 'Reporty investment' and Indyke in header.
sources.limit: Destination-bank rendering differs across instruction/posted statement; amount/date/beneficiary/account reconcile.

sources.supports: Posted Southern Trust $1M Reporty/ERGO transaction evidence.
sources.limit: BANK-4 funding does not fully reconstruct final holder/share count.

sources.supports: Barak describes Darren as JE's lawyer and proposes lawyer-to-lawyer follow-through on Reporty investment paperwork.
sources.limit: Role description does not prove every task performed.

sources.supports: Signed Levitection/Radar term-sheet materials described as sent to Darren.
sources.limit: No definitive close or funding recovered.

sources.supports: Deutsche exhibit lists Darren K. Indyke PLLC, profession Attorney, within SFR affiliate/account framework.
sources.limit: Onboarding category can mean several roles and does not identify deal-selection authority.

open_questions: Who originally sourced each of the four companies/opportunities.
Who held final investment-decision authority deal by deal.
Whether additional Indyke-executed technology investments exist outside the four source-locked examples.
Which transaction documents, if any, further separate legal review from bank-signatory authority.
not_established: That Indyke selected the portfolio companies.
That his presence proves a deal funded.
That he controlled the operating companies.
Criminal purpose arising from recurring legal, administrative or banking work.
